name: Autodesk Fusion (MCP)
summary: Talks to Fusion's MCP Server add-in on this computer while Fusion is open. The tool names below are placeholders: list the real ones with mcp_server_tools before proposing. Reading the design runs at once; anything that changes the design waits for the person every time.
setup: In Fusion, open Preferences, General, API and tick Fusion MCP Server. Note the port it shows.
Tell External Service the port so it can fill in the address, then approve the connection and press Test.
Keep Fusion open whenever agents or the Fusion tab should use it.

operations.description: Bodies, components and parameters of the open design (read-only).

operations.name: run_script
operations.description: Run a script that changes the design. Waits for the person every time.
